SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm the route and actual time devoted to angling rather than assuming a rafting itinerary is a fishing trip. Pack to the boat transfer allowance and agree on rod protection before departure.

Choose a reach and presentation

A river name is not a complete day plan. Decide the reach, bank access and presentation first. Ask for the useful lure weight or fly-line arrangement, then match the rod, reel and leader to that answer. Wading is a separate decision and is not assumed in this brief.

What is established—and what is not

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Nepal

Protected-area fishing needs the relevant park or conservation-area permit. A park entrance ticket does not itself establish fishing permission, and rules outside protected areas need a local check.

Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Bardia National Park fishing permission ↗
    Anglers whose Babai or Karnali route enters Bardia National Park Apply to the park administration through the trip operator.
  • Bardia National Park entry ↗
    Visitors entering Bardia National Park Obtain the park entry ticket at the park office or through the operator.

Rules for this water

  • For a Bardia park reach, obtain the park’s fishing permission and follow the authorised place, method and dates.
